title: The receipt arrives after the reconcile budget or a newer turn
description: The commit receipt arrives after the reconcile budget expired or after the caller moved to a newer turn; the late receipt must reconcile the ledger without speaking stale success into the newer turn.
callerVisible: A late confirmation is not spoken into an unrelated newer turn; the caller hears it at the next appropriate point or in a follow-up.
backendEvidence: Late receipt applied to the ledger by idempotency key
Stale speech dropped by turn id / session generation
notes: Added to the fixed fault registry for the follow-on prompt section 17 fault matrix. The LOCAL FIXTURE driver does not inject it (NOT_SUPPORTED); only the Layer-2 run tagged [FAULT:RECEIPT_LATE] owned by WP-25 proves it.

registry.injectionPoint: the receipt arrives after the reconcile budget or after a newer turn

postconditions: The late receipt reconciles the ledger exactly once
No stale success utterance is released into a newer turn (ACT-05)
